name: Naishitai: The parts I'm missing.
source:
This is a short experience where you dwell into the mind of Nai, who is unable to let go of the past.

Naishitai is an experimental visual novel that features some gameplay mechanics that help tell a story. It touches on some harsh topics like suicide and self-harm in a way that might be brutal and uncomfortable.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4416070/Naishitai_The_parts_Im_missing/]Steam[/url]]
